handoff.objective: Repair the four defects EV-HQC-75c05b records, as a VERSIONED AMENDMENT proposal. You design and calibrate; you do not run a measurement arm and you do not edit the approved contract.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the EXP-HQC-982268 instrument can be made fit for its measurement at all, and at what allocation -- currently its falsification criterion is mis-sized by 30-80x and its primary control cannot fail, so no measurement it produces would be interpretable.
constraints: REPAIR R1 -- INV-NULL. It is ALSO the contract falsification criterion, so it must be sized before it is ever used for a verdict. Measure its realized size under the exact null and replace the jackknife Wald rule with one whose size you have MEASURED, not assumed. Report the achieved size per (set,k).

REPAIR R2 -- CTRL-BS. It is the contract PRIMARY control and it cannot fail upstream of the indicator matrix: np.roll is a permutation preserving per-block marginals exactly. Demote it, and design a control that CAN fail there. State, before running anything, the forced value that control takes under a correct instrument and the observation that would break it.
REPAIR R3 -- D3. Restate it as the hard invariant it is, and remove the claim that it discriminates (T) from (M). If you can design a real (T)-vs-(M) discriminator, propose it; if you cannot, say so.
REPAIR R4 -- allocations. Re-derive T_stab and T_req at the MEASURED q-hat for all four sets, and either fund PS-R1/PS-R5 or restate success criterion (iv) around PS-R3. Show the arithmetic.

REPAIR R5 -- oracle gate. The current one compares oracle.py against its own output and never ingests stage_a.py output. Promote the red-team CTRL-ORACLE cross-check (oracle law_of_S through log2_A_from_hist, max diff 1.2e-14) into the amendment as the real gate.
DO NOT run any measurement arm, and do not compute log2_A_k or log2_A_m on any space-(T) arm. Calibration draws under an explicit null are permitted and are what R1 needs.
Write a PROPOSED AMENDMENT under your own directory. Do NOT edit experiments/EXP-HQC-982268/specification.yaml -- only a Coordinator ledger archive may amend an approved contract.
Budget 1200 core-seconds. Report timings. Exhaustion is an infrastructure outcome, never a result.
